_comment: Curated, reputable Microsoft Edge extension baseline shipped with devsetup. Applied via the Edge ExtensionSettings/ExtensionInstallForcelist policy (installation_mode: normal_installed, so users can remove them). IDs are Microsoft Edge Add-ons store IDs; update_url is the Edge Add-ons CRX endpoint. Known privacy/security-risk extensions (free VPNs, video downloaders, webcam access) are intentionally excluded.
